ModuleDescription: PICO eye and face tracking for VRCFaceTracking, receiving data from PicoFacialBridge, PICO Connect, Streaming Assistant, or PicoFacialDataDaemon. Gaze comes from the EyeLook expression model and eyelids from 1 - EyeBlink; native eye packets supply a measured pupil diameter. Supports independent per-eye eye expressions and configurable expression processing.
UsageInstructions: Disable older PICO tracking modules, install this module, and restart VRCFaceTracking 5.4.5. Gaze is derived from the EyeLook shapes and eyelid openness from 1 - EyeBlink for every sender. With PicoET-Enhance v2.2.0+ and PicoFacialBridge v0.4.0+, per-eye independent eye-expression X packets and measured pupil diameter are supported; an invalid eye holds its own last value. EyeWide is amplified 2x; other expression corrections are off. Explicit settings in UnifiedPicoModule.json take precedence. See the README for configuration and validation details.
